title: Canonical Cartier pole reduction data
statement: Let $i:D\hookrightarrow Z$ be an effective Cartier divisor, with integral pole-extension boundary $\beta_{\mathrm{et}}$ specified by [def-sp-cartier-pole-boundary]. Use the comparison inverse image $\nu^{-1}$ of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], units and the Kummer sequence of [sk-def-kummer], constant sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], pro-etale direct image of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], roots of unity of [def-pur-roots-of-unity-sheaf], and Ext in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The finite supported constants and finite Tate lines are those of [sk-lem-geo-cartier]. Define the following canonical data: the unique pole boundary $\beta_{\mathrm{et}}$ with local quotient $t^{-1}\mapsto+1$; the supported-source isomorphism $\nu_Z^{-1}i_{\mathrm{et},*}\mathbf Z_D\simeq i_{\mathrm{proet},*}\mathbf Z_D$ induced by the direct-image adjunction mate and constant-sheaf comparison; and, for a positive integer $n$ invertible on $Z$ and a finite commutative ring $A$ with $nA=0$, the supported coefficient-unit map induced by $1\mapsto1$ and the root-to-Tate-line map induced by the roots comparison and $\zeta\mapsto\zeta\otimes1$. The pro-etale reduced class is the unique supported module-Ext class whose scalar adjunct is the entire pole boundary, pushed to full pro-etale units, followed by the positive Kummer connecting map and this root-to-Tate-line map. In particular put $R_{\ell,r}=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$ (lifted to the sheaf universe), with its specified annihilation $\ell^r=0$, and use this construction to define $c_{\ell,r}(i)$ for a prime $\ell$ invertible on $Z$ and $r\geq1$. These are definitions of the maps, not the site-comparison theorem about them.
